uniqueFeatures.title: Player Settings
uniqueFeatures.description: Custom player settings for things such as mob spawning, phantoms and teleport preferences.

uniqueFeatures.title: Custom Auction House
uniqueFeatures.description: A custom Auction House with features built specifically for LathSMP.

uniqueFeatures.title: Smart RTP
uniqueFeatures.description: Random teleportation with separate Overworld, Nether and End systems.

uniqueFeatures.title: Player Statistics
uniqueFeatures.description: Player statistics and leaderboards for things such as playtime, kills and other server activity.

server.noClaimsText: LathSMP does not use traditional land-claim protection. Players have to think about where and how they build and protect their stuff.

about.title: About LathSMP
about.description: LathSMP is a custom made Minecraft server made by me and my twin for my friends and community :D
about.whyText: The goal of LathSMP is to build a Minecraft server that truly feels like LathSMP. LathSMP will have systems that belong to LathSMP rather, than just using a collection of default plugins.
